content_sections.heading: ANGRAU Teaching Associate Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ANGRAU Teaching Associate Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ANGRAU Teaching Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a walk-in interview, and the walk-in date is 13th August 2026. Candidates should report on this date with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Teaching Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Ph.D. in the relevant subject or a Master's degree with at least 3 years of teaching/research experience, a Bachelor's degree in Agriculture with first division, and a published research paper in a SCI/NAAS rated journal.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the ANGRAU Teaching Associate position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 45 years. There is an age relaxation of up to 40 years for men and 45 years for women.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Teaching Associate role?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 61,000/- + HRA for Master's degree holders and Rs. 67,000/- + HRA for Ph.D. holders per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Teaching Associate post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Teaching Associate post announced by ANGRAU.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this ANGRAU recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in Bapatla, Andhra Pradesh. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University.
